review.summary: Initial public baseline: signatures reverified; constructor decoding and callback assignment independently reproduced; full JNI and gameplay remain unresolved.

evidence: Base and ARM64 split pass APK v3 and SourceStamp verification; manifest reports 160402020.
JADX processed 9,575 input classes with 200 errors; startup and JNI declarations recovered.
libg ELF metadata yields 566 dynamic-symbol entries including createGameMain and JNI_OnLoad.
Decoded configuration identifies /proc/self/maps, the supporting library, and dispatch offset 0x681780.
Constructor returns; 583,618 mapped image bytes change after relocation and JNI startup becomes readable. Full JNI/runtime and gameplay remain incomplete.
No troop movement algorithm has been recovered.
No target acquisition algorithm has been recovered.
No collision or avoidance algorithm has been recovered.
No attack, damage, or timing algorithm has been recovered.
No per-tick comparison against the original battle runtime has been run.
